messages:
Zoe: Quick ask we need a one-page field brief + 3 webinar intro slides that tie security, SLAs, and deploy modes together. Keep it < 400 words.
Arman: I'll draft the one-pager. Structure: 1) pain statement 2) our solution (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) neutral benchmark vignette 4) routing rules + CTA.
Talia: For benchmark vignette use non-numeric language: 'Teams moved to reserved capacity and caching to reduce latency variability and prevent surprise costs.'
Ben: Routing rules (examples):
```
- keywords: ["security","compliance"] -> route: ae-security
- keywords: ["sla","p95","throughput"] -> route: enterprise-sales
- keywords: ["private","vpc","on-prem"] -> route: platform-sales
- fallback -> growth
```
Zoe: Headlines to A/B test on landing: A) "Secure, SLA-backed LLM inference" B) "Predictable LLM performance for regulated apps". CTAs: "Request capacity review" + "Book security walkthrough".
Arman: I'll share a draft link by EOD Tue. Talia will proof the benchmark wording. ops-bot: Reminder set draft due Tue 17:00 UTC, slides due Wed 09:00 UTC.
